action.objective: Complete broad-search coverage over all legal White root moves at depth 4 to establish baseline scores before selecting a candidate.
action.rationale: This is the mandatory first broad_search phase: no prior analyses exist, replan_required is false, and allowed_actions is only analyze. Using candidate_moves=[] to enumerate every legal root move satisfies the coverage requirement. Node budget 3000 (half of 6000) and depth 4 (max) give a full baseline; the remaining budget is reserved for single-candidate verification.
